acquisition_order: Shared F32 loading: Wan denoiser and text projection are two production consumers with identical decode semantics. Measure complete loader allocations, peak, wall and exact tensor content before replacement.
Wan guided-step input reuse: measure denoiser and decoder separately on frozen G3/G4 plus full-clip requests; preserve output quality and profile actual bytes before changing transfers.
Shared GIF timing: decode all frozen clips and compare pixels, order and cumulative duration without rerunning unchanged model inference.
Catalog reuse: compare the same selected-task model identities with and without the existing memo; share work between report and exporter.
Defer typed LiveEdit handoff until preparation observations show that its avoided serialization warrants the wider session-director change.

candidates.change: Replace manual full-byte-buffer decoding with the existing safetensors.ReadF32 owner while retaining each caller's dtype, shape and tensor-selection checks.
candidates.cohort: Wan denoiser and text projection are two production consumers. Krea textencoder and VAE loaders serve host/reference paths; the active resident GPU path uses compileResidentWeights and must not inherit a GPU-speed claim from these changes.
candidates.effect: Eliminate one tensor-sized float32 byte buffer and its decoding loop per selected tensor. Measure total allocated bytes, process peak, loading wall and bitwise tensor equality.
candidates.limitations: Source header extents predict avoided copies, not process peak. Map iteration and Go collection affect measured peak. Preserve both F32 exactness and F16/BF16 promotion; do not broaden Wan's declared F32 checkpoint contract.

candidates.change: Evaluate uploading the shared patch and timestep inputs once per guided timestep, then reuse them for conditional and unconditional graph calls through existing device buffers.
candidates.cohort: Wan numerical G3/G4 requests plus the frozen full-clip request. Preserve UniPC, branch context identity, output-head ownership, and cancellation/repeated-request behavior.
candidates.effect: The two branch calls receive the same patch_tokens, conditioning_block and conditioning_head. Avoiding the second upload should remove one complete input set per timestep; derive bytes from actual tensor shapes and dtype.
candidates.limitations: A lower HtoD count alone does not establish faster end-to-end generation. Head outputs still return to the host for unpatchify, guidance and UniPC. Do not cache by host pointer identity because an input slice may be mutated in place.

candidates.change: Evaluate a typed request handoff in the existing session director to remove the resolved clip request's internal JSON encode/string/decode round trip.
candidates.cohort: The frozen LiveEdit tensor cases and a declared clip-form request. Exercise the shared director with another real typed consumer before claiming shared handoff consolidation.
candidates.effect: Avoid copying and parsing decoded source pixels and compiled conditioning before model preparation; retain required durable request and mapped-input publication.
candidates.limitations: The director still creates a request identity and mapped source/condition artifacts. Oversized request digests preserve identity but are not a substitute for the source and condition artifacts needed for replay.

candidates.change: Use cumulative centisecond quantization in the shared GIF timing owner and migrate both encoder consumers.
candidates.cohort: All seven frozen video cases, including 16 fps Wan/LiveEdit and 8 fps Un-0. Add boundary coverage for unsupported frame rates and arithmetic overflow.
candidates.effect: Correct accumulated duration error while preserving decoded frame pixels and order. Retain original encoded artifacts and their original byte-oracle outcomes.
candidates.limitations: This is a correctness change. It does not establish a throughput, memory, motion-quality or temporal-conditioning improvement.

candidates.change: Use selected-task catalog reads and the existing stat-validated digest memo in both report and sample consumers.
candidates.cohort: Both report and sample-export discovery with the frozen image/video task selection.
candidates.effect: Avoid hashing unrelated model files or repeating unchanged file hashes. Compare identical catalog results and publication artifacts before measuring elapsed time.
candidates.limitations: The earlier complete census took 4.22 seconds with its existing memo; the earlier un-memoized inspection had a different scope and no retained exact wall time. Those observations are not a matched speedup comparison.

shared_owners.responsibility: ResidentSession owns immutable device inputs, shared allocations and compiled programs; reuse it when lifetimes and layouts agree.
Executor pools dynamic device buffers; retained outputs keep storage alive through its final consumer.
MemoryStats accounts one Library's allocations; ExecutionStats counts submitted copies, launches and synchronizations.
ReadF32 converts into the final float32 allocation. MaterializeF32 selects tensors and retains shapes when requested.
Video geometry, planar frame copying, decode and shared GIF timing.
Process wall and working-set peak observations; isolate process lifetimes for peak comparisons.
Capability output, node timing and optional device peak; currently omits the executed workflow run identity.
Verification publication; currently does not bind the measured request and generated output/run to verifier evidence.
Runtime owns recipe-node execution and persisted input/output/run lineage.
The Windows capability binds the actual image executor and director; stored placement strings alone do not resolve CPU versus CUDA execution.
Worker owns one CUDA context and orders access on its locked OS thread; it carries operation contexts and terminates owned resources.

Existing host GEMM uploads and downloads are distinct from device-buffer VJP entrypoints. Do not substitute training helpers for retained generation graphs without a real caller and numerical contract.
Causal VAE owns weights, per-operation caches and reusable workspace; denoiser accounting does not include this owner.
Retained device sampling alternates evolving image buffers and copies only the final image to host.
